databases.description: List of databases to pool. Each entry maps a logical name to a PostgreSQL host, port, and database name.

name.description: Logical name used by clients to connect (e.g., `myapp`)

host.description: Hostname or IP of the PostgreSQL server

dbname.description: Database name on the PostgreSQL server

auth_user.description: User to authenticate as when connecting to the PostgreSQL server (optional)

listen_addr.description: IP address for pgbouncer to listen on for client connections (e.g., `0.0.0.0` for all interfaces)

listen_port.description: Port for pgbouncer to listen on for client connections

unix_socket_dir.description: Directory for Unix domain socket (required if using socket connections)

unix_socket_mode.description: File mode (permissions) for the Unix socket

auth_file.description: Path to file containing username/password entries

auth_user.description: Username used for user lookup via `pg_auth` (when using `auth_type = md5` with `auth_file`)

pool_mode.description: Pooling mode: `session` (default pgbouncer), `transaction` (recommended for web apps), or `statement`

max_client_conn.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections

default_pool_size.description: Number of server connections to keep per user/database pair

min_pool_size.description: Minimum number of server connections to maintain per user/database pair

max_server_conn.description: Maximum number of server connections (0 = unlimited). Prevents overwhelming PostgreSQL

server_idle_timeout.description: Seconds of idle time before server connection is closed (0 = no timeout)

log_pooler_errors.description: Log pooler errors (e.g., authentication failures, server connection failures)

admin_users.description: List of users allowed to connect to pgbouncer's internal admin database

stats_users.description: List of users allowed to query statistics (e.g., `SHOW STATS`, `SHOW POOLS`)

log_file.description: Path to write log output (empty = log to stderr/stdout)

server_reset_query_always.description: Always run `server_reset_query` before returning connection to pool

server_reset_query.description: Query executed before returning a server connection to the pool

server_check_query.description: Query used to validate server connection health

server_check_delay.description: Seconds to wait before reusing a server after failed check

query_timeout.description: Maximum seconds for a query before logging a warning (0 = disabled)

connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for server connection before timing out

client_idle_timeout.description: Seconds of client inactivity before disconnect (0 = disabled)

max_query_count.description: Maximum queries per server connection before reset (0 = disabled)

delayed_client_start.description: Delay client startup after idle server (e.g., `5s`) to reduce connection churn

reserve_pool_size.description: Extra connections reserved for admin users or failover

reserve_pool_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a reserve pool connection before falling back to new connection

resolve_conf.description: Disable DNS lookups (set to `true` for immediate resolution via `/etc/hosts`)

tcp_fastopen.description: Enable TCP Fast Open (kernel support required)

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate for client connections

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key for client connections

tls_ca.description: Path to CA certificate for client TLS verification

tls_crl.description: Path to certificate revocation list (CRL) for client TLS

server_tls_mode.description: TLS mode for pgbouncer ↔ PostgreSQL connections

server_tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate for pgbouncer ↔ PostgreSQL

server_tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key for pgbouncer ↔ PostgreSQL

server_tls_ca.description: Path to CA certificate for PostgreSQL TLS verification

server_tls_crl.description: Path to CRL for PostgreSQL TLS verification
